This native atlas supplies Quistis's whip, keeping the orange outfit and blonde hair while correcting unarmed generic poses. Original generated choreography, not certified official-source frames.

entries.name: Seifer Almasy
entries.sourceWork: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Seifer Almasy: Fire Cross / No Mercy
entries.sourceReference: Seifer's original FFVIII identity uses his long light-gray/white coat with red cross motifs and the Hyperion gunblade. No Mercy is his Fire Cross Limit Break. The local black fur-collar jacket is a known reference mistake, explicitly corrected rather than copied.
entries.identityCorrection: Canonical costume and weapon correction authorized: replace the mistaken short black fur-collar jacket (Squall-like) with Seifer's long light-gray/white coat, red crosses, black undershirt, dark trousers, black gloves and Hyperion. Preserve blonde hair, adult male identity and FFVIII era, no alternate-game redesign.
